name: Clarence Jiyu Sun
bio: Jiyu is a master’s student in Information Technology at the University of Auckland. He joined to the Augmented Human Lab (AHLab) for an intern on the Real-time Emotion Detection using raw audio signals. His primary interest is using AI and big data technology to solve real problems in the world. He has experiences on machine learning engineer and full-stack software engineer, especially on marketing precision. Basketball is his favourite.
